== msvc ==
kind=msvc
name=msvc
exec[ar]=lib.exe
exec[as]=ml64.exe
exec[cc]=cl.exe
exec[link]=link.exe
flags.include=/Iv
flags.define=/Dv
flags.library=v.lib
flags.library_path=/LIBPATH:v
flags.output=/Fov.obj
flags.compile_only=/c
default_cflags=/O2 /W3 /MD
obj_ext=.obj exe_ext=.exe
location=Env
== gcc ==
kind=gcc
name=gcc
exec[ar]=ar.exe
exec[as]=as.exe
exec[cc]=gcc.exe
exec[link]=gcc.exe
flags.include=-Iv
flags.define=-Dv
flags.library=-lv
flags.library_path=-Lv
flags.output=-ov
flags.compile_only=-c
default_cflags=-O2 -Wall
obj_ext=.o exe_ext=
location=Env

== iar ==

name=iar

exec[as]=iasmarm.exe
exec[cc]=iccarm.exe
exec[link]=ilinkarm.exe

flags.define=-Dv
flags.library=-lv
flags.library_path=-Lv
flags.output=-ov
flags.compile_only=--debug
default_cflags=--no_cse --no_unroll --no_inline --no_code_motion --no_tbaa --no_clustering --no_scheduling --debug --endian=little --cpu=Cortex-M4 -e --fpu=VFPv4_sp
obj_ext=.o exe_ext=
location=Env
